name: The Hunter's Way
summary: In Mulgore, Skorn Whitecloud guides aspiring trackers through the Hunter's Way. To prove their skill and respect for the wild, you hunt flatland prowlers and bring their claws to Melor Stonehoof on Thunder Bluff's Hunter Rise.

sections.title: A Tradition of the Plains
sections.body: For the tauren, hunting is among the highest honors. It calls for patience, attention to the Earth Mother's balance, and respect for the beasts across the plains. Elder Skorn Whitecloud has spent decades tracking across Kalimdor and now rests in Mulgore. He sees young adventurers eager to roam and gives them a traditional trial to shape their ambition into discipline.

sections.title: The Stalkers of the Grasslands
sections.body: Flatland prowlers test a candidate's tracking skill. These great cats move swiftly and quietly, hiding in Mulgore's high grass before ambushing their prey. Bring four sets of claws to show you can spot a predator before it catches you, then turn its ferocity against it.

sections.title: Reaching Hunter Rise
sections.body: After gathering the claws, you climb the wooden towers and bridges to Thunder Bluff's Hunter Rise. Melor Stonehoof receives the trophies there. A master tracker who values Skorn Whitecloud's ancient wisdom, Melor accepts them as proof that you have the spirit to learn more of Kalimdor's hunting ways.

faq.q: Who offers the task to walk the Hunter's Way?
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud, an elder resting in Mulgore, offers the trial to young adventurers eager to master the wilderness.

faq.q: Where do I take the flatland prowler claws?
faq.answer: Bring the flatland prowler claws to Melor Stonehoof on the Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why are flatland prowler claws chosen as the tribute?
faq.answer: Flatland prowlers are stealthy, dangerous hunters of Mulgore's grasslands. Tracking and defeating them tests the sharp eyes, patience, and discipline needed for advanced hunting.

faq.q: Is this quest restricted only to the Hunter class?
faq.answer: No. Skorn Whitecloud offers this test to any young Horde adventurer eager to roam and learn the traditions of the plains.

faq.q: Where does the hunter's journey lead after speaking to Melor?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof recognizes your growing talent and directs you toward the harsher Barrens, where experienced trackers such as Sergra Darkthorn can guide you.

faq.q: What significance does hunting hold in tauren culture?
aliases: why is hunting important to tauren
faq.answer: For the tauren, hunting is among the highest honors. It means living in harmony with the Earth Mother's creation, taking only what is needed, and respecting the quarry that sustains the tribes.

angles.text: As a young tauren, bringing prowler claws to Hunter Rise marks a rite of passage tied to generations of ancestors who hunted these same plains.
As a Hunter, you are tested on the wild's core lessons: stalk an ambush predator before it strikes, and read the grasslands' subtle signs.
As a Horde wanderer, you can learn tauren reverence for nature and earn their trust on Thunder Bluff's heights.
